'When this attacks, you may destroy a Lightning Flow you control. If you do, this gets go again.' The grant stays on ON_ATTACK and the keyword is declared conditional, so the printed GoAgain no longer applies when there is no Lightning Flow to destroy.

STILL NOT EXACT: the destroy is written as mandatory, so a player who would rather keep the Lightning Flow has no choice, and the go again follows automatically whenever they control one. The printed text is 'you MAY'.
